title: Cross-Platform Application Migration to HarmonyOS: An Agentic Pipeline with Artifact-Derived Verification
title_zh: 跨平台应用迁移至鸿蒙：基于产物推导验证的智能体流水线

paragraphs.en: The migration of applications written for a different platforms like Android or iOS to HarmonyOS NEXT requires a complete rewrite in ArkTS. Although LLMs automate the translation of source constructs into ArkTS, syntactic compilation is not enough and functional assurance is a critical open challenge in HarmonyOS NEXT migration. We present HMOS Migrator, an agentic pipeline that reads an application’s source code, generates an ArkTS project, and validates the result by replaying recorded interactions on a real device. We cast the scoring problem as quality estimation without a reference implementation; we score a migration using only the source application’s recorded behaviour and the artifacts produced by the pipeline. We define seven weighted metrics, each constructed so that reduced measurement cannot artificially raise the score. Over twelve runs across six open-source applications, the pipeline’s structural reproduction is high (completeness 83.3 %–100.0 %), while on-device behaviour (4.3 %–63.1 %) and UI fidelity (21.1 %–63.2 %) remain the primary limits. Scores improve steadily over time: + 0.45 +0.45 points per day overall ( R 2 = 0.44 R^{2}=0.44 , p = 0.019 p=0.019 ) and + 0.47 +0.47 over the model-free subset ( R 2 = 0.39 R^{2}=0.39 , p = 0.029 p=0.029 ), with corresponding to fit angles of + 8.4 ∘ +8.4^{\circ} and + 11.7 ∘ +11.7^{\circ} respectively.

paragraphs.en: HarmonyOS NEXT applications use the ArkTS and ArkUI programming model [ 10 ] rather than the Android runtime. Consequently, an existing Android or iOS application must be reconstructed for the target ecosystem rather than simply repackaged. Manual migration requires substantial effort across application logic, data access, UI construction, resources, navigation, and platform services. Large language models make this reconstruction amenable to automation, but application-scale migration also requires systematic execution and validation.
paragraphs.zh: HarmonyOS NEXT 应用采用 ArkTS 与 ArkUI 编程模型[10]，而非 Android 运行时。 因此，现有的 Android 或 iOS 应用必须面向目标生态系统进行重构，而不能简单地重新打包。 手动迁移需要在应用逻辑、数据访问、UI 构建、资源、导航以及平台服务等方面投入大量工作。 大语言模型使这种重构可以实现自动化，但应用规模的迁移还需要系统化的执行与验证。

paragraphs.en: We present HMOS Migrator, a fully automated agentic pipeline that carries an application from source repository to an installable HarmonyOS application and an artifact-derived verification report. In the measured NetNewsWire run, 117.8 × 10 3 117.8\times 10^{3} source lines were processed in 17.9 h wall-clock time, equivalent to approximately 15.2 h per 100 × 10 3 100\times 10^{3} source lines. Thus, an application of this scale can be migrated within a working day rather than through a multi-day manual port. The pipeline also records model usage and execution evidence, allowing both migration cost and output quality to be measured reproducibly.

paragraphs.en: Our second contribution is an artifact-derived verification scheme for a setting in which no independently implemented target application is available as a reference. The source application supplies recorded states and interaction traces, while the migration run supplies target artifacts and execution evidence. Deterministic programs recompute published quantities directly from these artifacts, while model-based methods are used only for semantic or visual judgements. The resulting score is reported together with its evidence coverage rather than treating unobserved states as successful observations. We cast scoring as quality estimation without a reference implementation . No correct port exists to compare against. We have the source application, the states recorded from it, and the evidence the run leaves behind.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的第二个贡献是一种基于产物的验证方案，适用于没有独立实现的目标应用程序可作为参照的场景。 源应用程序提供记录的状态与交互轨迹，而迁移运行提供目标产物与执行证据。 确定性程序直接从这些产物中重新计算已发布的量值，而基于模型的方法仅用于语义或视觉判断。 所得的分数与其证据覆盖率一同报告，而不是将未被观测到的状态视为成功的观测。 我们将评分设定为无参照实现的质量估计。 不存在可供对比的正确移植版本。 我们拥有源应用程序、从其中记录的状态，以及该运行留下的证据。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate twelve migrations of six open-source applications and report both end-to-end verification results and measured execution cost. The evaluation demonstrates autonomous, application-scale migration from both Android and iOS, quantifies the associated time and token costs, and assesses the reproducibility and coverage of artifact-based verification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了六个开源应用的十二次迁移，并报告端到端验证结果和测得的执行成本。 该评估展示了从 Android 和 iOS 两个平台进行的自主、应用规模的迁移，量化了相关的时间和 token 成本，并评估了基于制品的验证的可复现性和覆盖率。

paragraphs.en: This work makes three primary contributions: (1) the migration pipeline (Section III ); (2) a verification framework demonstrating how naive metrics can reward reduced measurement (Section IV ); and (3) an end-to-end evaluation spanning twelve runs across six applications, uniformly rescored under a single code state (Sections V ).
paragraphs.zh: 本工作有三个主要贡献：(1) 迁移流水线（第 III 节）；(2) 一个验证框架，展示朴素指标如何奖励测量量的减少（第 IV 节）；(3) 一项端到端评估，涵盖六个应用的十二次运行，并在单一代码状态下统一重新评分（第 V 节）。

paragraphs.en: The closest prior work evaluates ArkTS generation at the prompt level rather than application scale. Erkuş et al. [ 1 ] introduce a 300-prompt ArkTS benchmark covering 21 models and report low functional correctness, with the best model achieving 22.7 % Pass@1; performance is lower on UI tasks than on algorithmic tasks. Aytekin et al. [ 2 ] propose Iterative Compilation Feedback, where models iteratively repair generated code using compiler feedback, increasing syntactic Pass@1 to 91 %.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的先前工作是在提示层面而非应用规模上评估ArkTS生成。Erkuş等人 [ 1 ] 提出了一个包含300个提示、覆盖21个模型的ArkTS基准，并报告了较低的功能正确性，最佳模型的Pass@1仅为22.7%；其在UI任务上的表现低于算法任务。Aytekin等人 [ 2 ] 提出了迭代编译反馈方法，即模型利用编译器反馈迭代修复生成的代码，将语法Pass@1提升至91%。

paragraphs.en: UI migration has also been studied through rule-based transpilation [ 3 ] , which translates code horizontally between readable languages. These approaches target platforms with established correspondences between source and target UI frameworks. Ours has none, so each screen must be reconstructed rather than rewritten. Nor is there a correct target implementation to compare the result against, which is why quality must be estimated from the source application’s own recorded behaviour. Additionally, visual layout matching alone cannot verify functional correctness, as a visually accurate screen may still fail to operate. Nor is a language model a dependable translator: Pan et al. [ 4 ] catalogue the bugs introduced when models translate code between languages, which is the class of defect our verification exists to expose. Interaction-trace transfer provides a more relevant benchmark for our validation stage [ 5 , 6 ] , yet prior work assumes both applications are already fully implemented. In our setting, the target app is dynamically synthesized during migration. Replay thus fulfills two essential roles: exercising the generated codebase and producing trace data for cross-application behavioral comparison.
paragraphs.zh: UI 迁移还通过基于规则的转译得到研究[3]，即在可读语言之间进行水平代码转换。 这些方法面向源 UI 框架与目标 UI 框架之间已有既定对应关系的平台。 而我们的场景没有任何对应关系，因此每个屏幕都必须重新构建，而非简单改写。 也不存在可用来对照结果的正确目标实现，这正是必须从源应用自身记录的行为来估计质量的原因。 此外，仅靠视觉布局匹配无法验证功能正确性，因为视觉上准确的屏幕仍可能无法正常运行。 语言模型也不是可靠的翻译器：Pan 等人 [4] 编目了模型在语言间翻译代码时引入的缺陷，而这正是我们的验证机制所要暴露的一类缺陷。 交互轨迹迁移为我们的验证阶段提供了更相关的基准[5,6]，但已有工作都假设两个应用均已完整实现。 在我们的设定中，目标应用是在迁移过程中动态合成的。 因此，重放承担了两个关键作用：运行生成的代码库，以及产出用于跨应用行为比较的轨迹数据。

paragraphs.en: Quality estimation without a reference is well established in machine translation. Referential Translation Machines [ 7 ] estimate translation quality without access to a reference translation, while Biçici [ 8 ] predicts translation performance from the source alone. Our setting differs from both: there is no independently implemented target application, but recorded source states are available and replayed target states can be compared with them directly. We therefore adopt the quality-estimation perspective rather than its predictive machinery. In particular, our estimator does not train a quality predictor or extract predictive features; instead, it derives scores from execution and UI artifacts and requires the score to remain sensitive to measurement coverage. The temporal trend analysis uses the normalized fit and angle statistic of [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 无参考的质量估计在机器翻译中已经相当成熟。 参考翻译机（Referential Translation Machines）[7] 在无法访问参考译文的情况下估计翻译质量，而 Biçici [8] 仅根据源文本预测翻译性能。 我们的设定与两者都不同：不存在独立实现的目标应用，但已记录的源状态是可用的，重放得到的目标状态可以直接与它们进行比较。 因此，我们采用质量估计的视角，而非其预测机制。 具体而言，我们的估计器不训练质量预测器，也不提取预测特征；相反，它从执行与 UI 产物中推导分数，并要求该分数对测量覆盖率保持敏感。 时间趋势分析使用了 [9] 的归一化拟合度和角度统计量。

sents.zh: 因此，我们采用质量估计的视角，而非其预测机制。

sents.en: In particular, our estimator does not train a quality predictor or extract predictive features; instead, it derives scores from execution and UI artifacts and requires the score to remain sensitive to measurement coverage.

paragraphs.en: The system consists of five phases (Fig. 1 ):

paragraphs.en: Phase 1 unified ingestion , which extracts source structure and runtime states; uses stable element identifiers, drives the source application to reach every navigable screen, and records a traversal graph whose nodes carry a screenshot and an index of the code repository. A node is a state : a screen plus the taps that reached it. The same screen reached two ways gives two states, so states outnumber screens.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段1统一摄取，提取源代码结构和运行时状态；使用稳定的元素标识符，驱动源应用到达每一个可导航的界面，并记录一张遍历图，其节点携带一张截图和代码仓库的索引。 节点即状态：一个界面加上到达它的那些点击操作。 同一个界面通过两条路径到达会得到两个状态，因此状态数量多于界面数量。

paragraphs.en: Three factors limit this interpretation. First, the sample contains only twelve runs: refitting without each run in turn leaves nine of twelve refits below the 0.05 0.05 level, and the three that cross it—dropping VLC 14/07, Image Toolbox or SwiftRadio—show how much the result rests on individual observations. paragraphs.en: We presented an evidence-based framework for evaluating AI-driven application migration from Android and iOS platforms to HarmonyOS even though the underlying pipeline is platform independent. Across twelve runs, structural reproduction was generally strong, while functional verification and UI fidelity remained the main limitations. The results show that successful generation and compilation do not establish behavioural correctness: replay coverage and on-device evidence are essential for determining whether the generated application actually works. The framework also preserves unexercised and unverifiable cases rather than treating them as successes, making the resulting scores auditable and reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管底层流程与平台无关，我们提出了一个基于证据的框架，用于评估将 AI 驱动的应用从 Android 和 iOS 平台迁移到鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）。 在十二次运行中，结构复现总体较强，而功能验证与 UI 还原度仍是主要局限。 结果表明，成功的生成与编译并不能确立行为正确性：回放覆盖率与真机证据对于判定生成的应用是否真正可用至关重要。 该框架还会保留未经测试和无法验证的用例，而不将其视为成功，从而使最终得分可审计、可复现。

sents.en: We presented an evidence-based framework for evaluating AI-driven application migration from Android and iOS platforms to HarmonyOS even though the underlying pipeline is platform independent.
sents.zh: 尽管底层流程与平台无关，我们提出了一个基于证据的框架，用于评估将 AI 驱动的应用从 Android 和 iOS 平台迁移到鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）。

sents.en: Across twelve runs, structural reproduction was generally strong, while functional verification and UI fidelity remained the main limitations.
sents.zh: 在十二次运行中，结构复现总体较强，而功能验证与 UI 还原度仍是主要局限。

sents.en: The results show that successful generation and compilation do not establish behavioural correctness: replay coverage and on-device evidence are essential for determining whether the generated application actually works.
sents.zh: 结果表明，成功的生成与编译并不能确立行为正确性：回放覆盖率与真机证据对于判定生成的应用是否真正可用至关重要。

sents.en: The framework also preserves unexercised and unverifiable cases rather than treating them as successes, making the resulting scores auditable and reproducible.
sents.zh: 该框架还会保留未经测试和无法验证的用例，而不将其视为成功，从而使最终得分可审计、可复现。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate results show a positive temporal trend, with a fitted increase of + 0.450 +0.450 points per day and a normalized angle of + 8.4 ∘ +8.4^{\circ} . The model-free aggregate increases by + 0.474 +0.474 points per day, corresponding to + 11.7 ∘ +11.7^{\circ} . These angles summarize the observed trend after normalizing the axes, but do not establish causal improvement because the corpus is small and spans different applications and model versions. Future work involves expanding the evaluation across more runs and time points and increase verification coverage to better separate improvements in generation capability from improvements in end-to-end migration quality.
paragraphs.zh: 总体结果显示出正向的时间趋势，拟合后的增长为每天 + 0.450 +0.450 分，归一化角度为 + 8.4 ∘ +8.4^{\circ}。 无模型的总计增长为每天 + 0.474 +0.474 分，对应于 + 11.7 ∘ +11.7^{\circ}。 这些角度总结了在坐标轴归一化后观察到的趋势，但由于语料库规模较小且跨越不同的应用和模型版本，因此并不能确立因果性的改进。 未来的工作包括在更多运行和时间点上扩展评估，并提高验证覆盖率，以便更好地区分生成能力方面的改进与端到端迁移质量方面的改进。
